rules: Use recipient final maximum HP,not caster HP or current HP
Re-evaluate when maximum HP changes,including finite grant duration
Native multiplication is final_hp*(value/100),with division first
Native adds HP-derived attack after ordinary scalar buff accumulation
layout_note: Legacy compiler uses kind4 with HP flag241 for this family;portable kind4 is a burst-stage override. Do not admit it by only adding a buff/stat name.
scope: 60 BuffManager cases with5 recipients and4 phases;no damage,battle,GPU or catalog certification
